Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.runner.json.module

Class BrobotJsonModule

java.lang.Object
com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.Module
com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.module.SimpleModule
io.github.jspinak.brobot.runner.json.module.BrobotJsonModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.fasterxml.jackson.core.Versioned, Serializable
@Component public class BrobotJsonModule extends com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.module.SimpleModule
Jackson module that configures custom serializers and deserializers for Brobot domain objects.

This module is the central configuration point for JSON processing of Brobot-specific classes and third-party library objects that require special handling. It registers custom serializers and deserializers to ensure proper JSON representation while avoiding common pitfalls like circular references, native memory structures, and heavyweight objects.

Registered serializers:

  • ActionConfig - Handles polymorphic action configuration with proper handling of enums and nested objects
  • ActionResult - Serializes match results while avoiding circular references
  • ObjectCollection - Handles collections of Brobot objects with state management
  • Mat - Converts OpenCV Mat objects to/from base64 encoded strings
  • Image - Serializes Brobot images with efficient handling of pixel data

Registered deserializers:

  • ActionConfig - Deserializes polymorphic action configuration objects
  • Image - Reconstructs Image objects from JSON with proper resource loading
  • SearchRegions - Deserializes search region configurations

This module works in conjunction with the mixin classes in io.github.jspinak.brobot.json.mixins to provide comprehensive JSON support for the entire Brobot object model.

    • BrobotJsonModule

      public BrobotJsonModule(MatchesSerializer matchesSerializer, ObjectCollectionSerializer objectCollectionSerializer, MatSerializer matSerializer, ImageSerializer imageSerializer, ActionConfigDeserializer actionConfigDeserializer, ImageDeserializer imageDeserializer, SearchRegionsDeserializer searchRegionsDeserializer, MatDeserializer matDeserializer)
      Constructs the BrobotJsonModule with all required serializers and deserializers.

      All serializers and deserializers are injected via Spring dependency injection, ensuring they are properly configured and ready for use.

      Parameters:
      matchesSerializer - Handles serialization of action results and match objects
      objectCollectionSerializer - Handles serialization of object collections with state references
      matSerializer - Handles serialization of OpenCV Mat objects to base64
      imageSerializer - Handles serialization of Brobot Image objects
      actionConfigDeserializer - Handles deserialization of polymorphic action configuration objects
      imageDeserializer - Handles deserialization of Brobot Image objects
      searchRegionsDeserializer - Handles deserialization of search region configurations
      matDeserializer - Handles deserialization of OpenCV Mat objects
